==English==
{{wp|<dab>}}
{{wp|Weekday names}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*dʰegʷʰ-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|Monday}}, {{m|enm|Monenday}}, from {{inh|en|ang|mōnandæġ||day of the moon}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*mānini dag}}, a calque ({{m|la|interpretātiō germānica}}) of {{der|en|la|diēs Lūnae}}, equivalent to {{af|en|Moon|day|nocat=1}}. See also {{cog|ja|月曜日||Moon's day}}.
{{col-top|2|cog}}
Compare {{cog|sco|Monanday|t=Monday}}, {{cog|yol|Mondei|t=Monday}}, {{cog|stq|Moundai|t=Monday}}, {{cog|fy|moandei|t=Monday}}, {{cog|gsw|meintog}}, {{m|gsw|miantag}}, {{m|gsw|méntag}}, {{m|gsw|mìntàg}}, {{m|gsw|mäntag}}, {{m|gsw|Määntig|t=Monday}}, {{cog|bar|Monda}}, {{m|bar|Mondåg}}, {{m|bar|montach}}, {{m|bar|monti|t=Monday}}, {{cog|cim|matak}}, {{m|cim|menta}}, {{m|cim|méentag|t=Monday}}, {{cog|nl|maandag|t=Monday}}, {{cog|de|Montag|t=Monday}}, {{cog|nds-de|Maandag|t=Monday}}, {{cog|lb|Méindeg|t=Monday}}, {{cog|mhn|ma'ta|t=Monday}}, {{cog|pdc|Mundaag}}, {{m|pdc|Muundaag|t=Monday}}, {{cog|wym|möntaog|t=Monday}}, {{cog|vls|moandag|t=Monday}}, {{cog|yi|מאָנטיק|t=Monday}}, {{cog|da|-}}, {{cog|nb|mandag|t=Monday}}, {{cog|fo|mánadagur|t=Monday}}, {{cog|is|mánudagur|t=Monday}}, {{cog|nn|-}}, {{cog|sv|måndag|t=Monday}}, {{cog|fi|maanantai|t=Monday}}.
{{col-bottom}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q105}}The second [[day]] of the week in many religious traditions, and the first day of the [[week]] in systems using the [[w:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] norm. It follows [[Sunday]] and precedes [[Tuesday]].
#: {{syn|en|Second Day|q=Quakerism}}
#* {{RQ:Orwell Animal Farm|6
|passage=Mr. Whymper, a solicitor living in Willingdon, {{...|had agreed to act as intermediary between Animal Farm and the outside world, and}} would visit the farm every '''Monday''' morning to receive his instructions.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Amir Vera|title=Louisville detective who fatally shot Breonna Taylor is appealing his termination from the police department|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/12/13/us/myles-cosgrove-breonna-taylor-termination-appeal-hearing/index.html|date=2021-12-13|passage=An LMPD Board Notice of Hearing states part of Cosgrove’s hearings took place in November. The second half of his hearing is set to begin '''Monday''' and end Wednesday.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220327164409/https://www.cnn.com/2021/12/13/us/myles-cosgrove-breonna-taylor-termination-appeal-hearing/index.html}}
